title: Upper Kharadi is 85% booked: MahaRERA numbers for the 8 big projects
audience: IT professionals and families, 28-45, working in Kharadi, Viman Nagar or Kalyani Nagar, budget ₹1.5-4 crore for a 2-4 BHK, planning to buy in Upper Kharadi in the next year; English
message: The 8 big projects sold as Upper Kharadi or Kharadi Annex have 3,876 homes on MahaRERA and 3,305 (85%) are booked; the towers finishing in 2027-28 are 92-100% booked, so what is open is mostly in 2029-2031 towers, and a flat to move into soon usually means resale.
facts: MahaRERA register read by Avasetu on 18 October 2026: the 8 big projects sold as Upper Kharadi or Kharadi Annex have 3,876 homes registered and 3,305 booked, which is 85 percent.
Lodha Giardino towers 1-4: 611 homes, 588 booked (96 percent), completion filed February 2027. Towers 5-8: 509 homes, 482 booked (95 percent).

Lodha Estilo: 212 homes, 195 booked (92 percent), completion 2028. Gera's Island of Joy: 620 homes, 600 booked (97 percent), September 2028. Gera's World of Joy tower M: 320 homes, all booked (100 percent), December 2027.

Lodha Camelot: 308 homes, 145 booked (47 percent), completion 2030-2031. Mahindra IvyLush (Kharadi Annex): 1,075 homes, 827 booked (77 percent), 2030. My Home Upper Kharadi: 143 homes, 102 booked (71 percent), April 2029. Lodha Kharadi Pune P1: 78 homes, 46 booked, October 2029.
The towers finishing in 2027 and 2028 are 92 to 100 percent booked; what is open is mostly in towers due between 2029 and 2031.
Godrej's 16-acre Upper Kharadi land had no MahaRERA registration on 18 October 2026.

caption:

🏢 3,876 homes registered, 3,305 booked (85%)
✅ Lodha Giardino T1-4: 96% booked, completion Feb 2027
✅ Gera's Island of Joy: 97%, Sep 2028
✅ Lodha Estilo: 92%, 2028
🟡 Mahindra IvyLush (Kharadi Annex): 77%, 2030
🟡 My Home Upper Kharadi: 71%, Apr 2029
